title: Pico (clang, permissive)
comment: PERMISSIVE (non-GPL) clang/LLVM replacement for the GPL pico-toolchain (src/arm-gcc). clang.wasm replaces cc1plus (frontend + integrated-as), lld.wasm replaces ld, compiler-rt (Apache-2.0) replaces libgcc, picolibc (BSD) replaces newlib. v0.2.0: a real Arduino-API sketch compiles with clang and links to a BOOTABLE UF2 for BOTH boards — RP2040 (clang-assembled boot2 + CRC, verify-core-boot.cjs) and RP2350 (clang-assembled IMAGE_DEF block loop, family 0xe48bff59, verify-core-boot-rp2350.cjs; IMAGE_TYPE byte-identical to the SDK, structurally validated not HW-booted). See src/pico-clang/build-core.sh + docs/CLANG_PICO.md.

core.sources: ArduinoCore-API (Common/Print/String) + arduino-pico stdlib_noniso + core/glue platform layer
